title: A Unified Control Framework for Gradient Inversion Defense in Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.32174v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Gradient perturbations are widely recognized as an effective defense against gradient inversion attacks in federated learning, but they are equally known to impair optimization, creating a persistent tension between privacy and utility. In this paper, we show that existing gradient perturbation defenses, despite their different formulations, can be unified under a controlled dynamics framework, providing a cohesive understanding of their optimization behavior and enabling the derivation of universal convergence and safety conditions without relying on case-specific analyses. Leveraging this observation, we propose ``Near Orthogonal Gradient Projection (NODE)'', which injects perturbations only along directions orthogonal to the original gradient so that the defended gradient maintains a fixed cosine similarity with the true gradient. translated_title: 联邦学习中梯度反演防御的统一控制框架
translated_abstract: 梯度扰动被广泛认为是抵御联邦学习中梯度反演攻击的有效手段，但同样众所周知的是，它也会损害优化过程，导致隐私与效用之间存在持续的矛盾。在本文中，我们证明现有的梯度扰动防御方法尽管公式形式各异，却可以在一个受控动力学框架下被统一起来，从而对其优化行为提供连贯一致的理解，并使得无需依赖针对具体案例的分析即可推导出通用的收敛性与安全性条件。基于这一观察，我们提出了“近正交梯度投影”，该方法仅沿与原始梯度正交的方向注入扰动，使得防御后的梯度与真实梯度之间保持固定的余弦相似度。通过保留一阶下降方向，NODE 大幅降低了更强扰动带来的优化成本。
tldr: 本文提出一个统一的受控动力学框架来刻画联邦学习中各类梯度扰动防御方法，并据此提出近正交梯度投影（NODE），仅沿正交方向注入扰动以保持梯度下降方向不变，从而在保障隐私的同时大幅降低优化开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified control framework for gradient perturbation defenses in federated learning and introduces Near Orthogonal Gradient Projection (NODE), which injects perturbations only along directions orthogonal to the original gradient, preserving the descent direction and substantially reducing optimization costs while ensuring privacy.
